verdict.rationale: Docusign claims central storage of agreements ("Securely store and access all your agreements in one place") and AI-powered finding and analysis of agreements via its IAM platform. Its MCP connector guide describes retrieving agreement metadata and querying key dates, which implies extracted metadata exists. However, no evidence explicitly describes automatic extraction of key terms and metadata from executed contracts into a searchable repository, so the core is only implied across marketing snippets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI key-term/metadata extraction on executed contracts, documented repository search and filter capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
